featured.reason: Composable skills methodology (brainstorm, plan, subagent TDD, review, verify) installable in Claude Code, Codex and many other harnesses.
ideas: Run its brainstorming → writing-plans flow on one small feature to get a reviewed spec and step-by-step plan before any code is written.
Try subagent-driven-development together with test-driven-development on a toy repo and compare the result with a normal single-agent session.
Use the using-git-worktrees skill to run two feature branches in parallel with separate agents, without them overwriting each other.
Learn the writing-skills skill and write your own SKILL.md (for example for this GitHub Trending archive routine) in the same composable format.
Install the same skill set in both Claude Code and Codex CLI (both documented) and compare how each harness triggers the skills.

featured.reason: Official Claude Code plugin marketplace: LSP, code-review, security, skill/plugin/MCP-dev plugins plus partner MCP integrations; trust each plugin before installing.
ideas: Add a language-server plugin (pyright-lsp, typescript-lsp, rust-analyzer-lsp, etc.) so Claude Code gets real diagnostics and go-to-definition in a project.
Run pr-review-toolkit or code-review on a real pull request and study how its review output is structured.
Use plugin-dev or skill-creator, with example-plugin as the reference, to package one of your own workflows as a plugin (plugin.json, commands, skills, .mcp.json).
Explore mcp-server-dev to scaffold a small read-only MCP server, for example one that exposes this archive's archive-index.json.
Study the marketplace.json rules (immutable names, the renames map, strict:false skill bundles) to host a private marketplace for your own skills.

featured.reason: Generates and catalogs agent-usable CLIs plus SKILL.md files for desktop software (Blender, draw.io, LibreOffice, Godot, Zotero and more); the target apps must be installed.
ideas: Install the drawio or mermaid harness and have an agent create and revise diagrams through the CLI instead of the GUI.
Use the blender or freecad harness to let Claude Code build a simple 3D or CAD model end to end with its preview loop.
Drive the libreoffice harness to generate or convert documents and slide decks from an agent session.
Follow HARNESS.md and skill_generator to wrap a desktop app you use that has no harness yet into an agent-native CLI with its own SKILL.md.
Combine the zotero and obsidian harnesses into a research-notes pipeline where an agent pulls citations into linked notes.
